labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Usage question: asks how to remove markup/style tags from a string. Rich's Text.from_markup(...).plain covers it.

body:
This is a usage question, so it's best asked in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions), where the maintainer can convert or close it.

To turn a string with markup into plain text without the styles, parse it with `Text.from_markup` and read `.plain`. See [markup.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/markup.rst) for the markup syntax. A closed related question is #2016.
